description: Equivalent Model and Aggregation Model of Inverter Air Conditioner for Power System Simulation is a model or code deposit deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yuqing Jin. "This dataset provides equivalent model and aggregation model of inverter air conditioners built on the Matlab platform, which can be used for power system simulation based on Matlab\/Simulink.". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
